title: Numerical evaluation of bi-facial ZnO/MoTe2 photovoltaic solar cells with N-doped Cu2O as the BSF layer for enhancing VOC via device simulation

Molybdenum telluride (MoTe2) shows great promise as a solar absorber material for photovoltaic (PV) cells owing to its wide absorption range, adjustable bandgap, and lack of dangling bonds at the surface.
